noAgentSubtitle: Agent-run discovery needs an up-to-date agent on the network to inventory.
agentHint: The probes run from this agent: choose one located on the target network.
scanDisabledTitle: Active scanning is disabled on this agent
scanDisabledBody: Port scans and SNMP probes need {option} in the agent configuration (or SUPERVISOR_ALLOW_NETWORK_SCAN=true), then an agent restart.
arpIntro: Reads the agent's ARP/neighbour table: the IPv4 neighbours it recently talked to. Passive: no packet is sent.
scanIntro: TCP connect scan of a private IPv4 range, with bounded concurrency and rate. Only scan networks you administer.
scanHint: Private addresses only (RFC 1918), from /{min} to /32. Ports: list or ranges (22,80,8000-8100), {max} at most.
confirmMessage:
{addresses} addresses × {ports} ports in {cidr}, from the agent {agent}.
The agent opens a TCP connection to every address and port.
snmpIntro: SNMP GET of the system group (name, description, uptime, contact, location) and an optional interface summary.
snmpSecretHint: Sent once to the agent, never stored or shown again. Passphrases: 8 characters minimum.
pollError: Could not fetch the discovery state
arpEmptySubtitle: The agent has no resolved neighbour yet.
scanPartialTimedOut: Maximum duration reached: partial result ({done} / {total} probes).
scanSummary: {hosts} address(es) with open ports out of {addresses} scanned, {ports} ports, in {duration}.
scanEmptySubtitle: No address answered on the scanned ports.
